'''2007 Worlds Day 2 Jonny Chu DS Agents Of Black Sun''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Jonny Chu]] at [[2007 World Championship]] (Day 2).

Player '''Chu''' → [[Jonny Chu]]. Deck title Fear. Sheet Agents In The Shadows → [[Agents Of Black Sun / Vengeance Of The Dark Prince|Agents Of Black Sun]]. Twisted Advisor → [[Twi'lek Advisor (V)]]; Relentless → [[Relentless Pursuit]]; Jabba's Court → Audience Chamber. Several shield OCR lines (Power Drain, Battle Order (V), Secret Plans (V)) mapped to nearest live titles.
